statement: The GitLab public home describes one platform for agentic software engineering, source control, CI/CD, security, and team delivery workflows.
The public GitLab application exposes project navigation for repository files, commits, branches, merge requests, pipelines, releases, members, and project metadata.
The captured public project is gitlab-org/gitlab-runner with main as its default branch and visible repository, commit, branch, and release routes.
Anonymous app captures attempted non-GET GraphQL and telemetry requests that policy blocked; several pages therefore rendered source error states instead of loaded dynamic data.
The source sign-in form was unavailable because Cloudflare security verification returned HTTP 403. No authenticated source session was supplied.

Account creation, dashboard, project creation, file commits, issues, merge requests, pipelines, membership, and settings were not mutated on the source because source mutations, real email, and authenticated access were not authorized.
Authenticated mutations are implemented as a site-isolated local SQLite contract and are not claimed as directly observed source behavior or source-pixel fidelity.
